subject: slice sampler reached maximum number of contractions

messages.author: 7fe97f8ba9e0dcfe
messages.subject: slice sampler reached maximum number of contractions
parts:
First, I just wanted to say thank you to this group for helping me learn NIMBLE and how to diagnose errors! It's awesome, and I appreciate it a lot.

I'm trying to model abundance of invasive species using a multinomial N-mixture model with removal count data. When fitting the model, I'm getting the error: "slice sampler reached maximum number of contractions for N[i]" for each element, i, in one of the stochastic nodes, which refers to this part of the model:

#binomial distribution --  observed sample size
 n_tot[i] ~ dbinom(pcap_time[i], N[i])
   
 #process model
 N[i] ~ dpois(lambda[i])

In other posts, it seems that this error arises from invalid initial values, but my initial values make sense to me. Here, I'm adding initial values so that N[i] > n_tot[i]:
inits_pois <- function(){ list (p_m = runif(1,0,0.1),
                                    p_f = runif(1,0,0.1),
                                    beta0 = runif(1,-2,2),
                                    N = n_tot+2)
} 

Do you have any suggestions for how this error can arise? Or any general tips for how to examine the nimbleModel object to diagnose errors like this? I've attached a reproducible version of the full model with simulated data. Perhaps the error is coming from somewhere else.

Thanks so much!

messages.author: 7fe97f8ba9e0dcfe
messages.subject: Re: slice sampler reached maximum number of contractions
parts: Just wanted to follow up and note that the error was coming from a small bug in my code that meant pcap_time[i] wasn't constrained to be <=1. Thanks to Perry for the catch.
